Sequencer opcodes:

| Opcode | Name | Payload | Effect |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `$00` | `MIA_SEQ_OP_END` |  | stop decoding this voice's track |
| `$01` | `MIA_SEQ_OP_NOTE` | freq_l, freq_h, dur_l, dur_m, dur_h | write FREQ_L/FREQ_H, gate off then on with phase reset so the envelope restarts from attack, last exactly dur ticks counting the decode tick (dur 0 lasts 1), advance note_index |
| `$02` | `MIA_SEQ_OP_REST` | dur_l, dur_m, dur_h | gate off, last exactly dur ticks counting the decode tick (dur 0 lasts 1), advance note_index |
| `$03` | `MIA_SEQ_OP_SET_WAVE` | waveform | write WAVEFORM |
| `$04` | `MIA_SEQ_OP_SET_ADSR` | attack_decay, sustain_release | write both envelope bytes |
| `$05` | `MIA_SEQ_OP_SET_PAN` | pan | write PAN |
| `$06` | `MIA_SEQ_OP_SET_VOL` | volume | write per-voice VOLUME |
| `$07` | `MIA_SEQ_OP_SET_PULSE` | pulse_width | write PULSE_WIDTH |
| `$08` | `MIA_SEQ_OP_JUMP` | offset_l, offset_m, offset_h | set cursor to (address right after this record) + offset, a signed 24-bit little-endian self-relative value; does not advance note_index; used for looping instead of a dedicated LOOP opcode |
| `$09` | `MIA_SEQ_OP_TIE` | freq_l, freq_h, dur_l, dur_m, dur_h | while the gate is up, write FREQ_L/FREQ_H only so the sounding note carries on without a new attack; with the voice released, or where catch-up resumes on it, act exactly like NOTE; last exactly dur ticks counting the decode tick (dur 0 lasts 1), advance note_index |
